subject: Onboarding: Streaming + Tool Calls + Structured Output (Next Steps)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura@healthsys.io>, Arvind Rao <arvind@healthsys.io>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: Streaming + Tool Calls + Structured Output (Next Steps)

Hi Laura / Arvind —

Great to meet last week. This thread is the formal handoff into our implementation plan for the features you asked to enable: streaming responses, function/tool-calling for internal workflows, and structured outputs (JSON schemas) for downstream ingestion. Goal: get you into a sandbox integration and a canary test within two weeks.

High-level next steps:
- Tech kickoff (1h): scope streaming + tool-calls, auth, and example schemas (owner: Dev).
- Provide JSON schema examples and an initial sample response from the Redwood streaming endpoint (owner: Dev).
- Integration checklist (access, firewall, test data, quotas) (owner: Monica).
- Canary run and review (owner: Rishi).

Attachments: Onboarding_Playbook_v1.pdf, json-schema-example.json, redwood-integration-checklist.xlsx

Can you confirm availability for a tech kickoff? I proposed Tue 2026-04-14 10:00 PT below but happy to move.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Onboarding_Playbook_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 420 KB)]

From: Laura Chen <laura@healthsys.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Arvind Rao <arvind@healthsys.io>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Streaming + Tool Calls + Structured Output (Next Steps)

Thanks Evelyn —

Tue 04/14 10:00 PT works for our engineering and data teams. A couple quick asks before the kickoff so we can prep:
1) Can you share a minimal JSON schema we can use to validate structured outputs? We want to align keys with our downstream ingestion.
2) For function/tool-calls: do you have example payloads and the recommended retry semantics if the tool returns 5xx?
3) Sandbox credentials / IP allowlist steps — share who to send firewall details to.

I attached a short list of data fields we plan to send during the canary.

Best,
Laura
VP Product, HealthSys
[Attachment: healthsys_canary_fields.csv (text/csv, 1 KB)]

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@healthsys.io>, Arvind Rao <arvind@healthsys.io>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Streaming + Tool Calls + Structured Output (Next Steps)

Team —

Following Dev's notes, I put together a short mutual action plan and owners so we can track the canary next week. Please reply with any conflicts.

Mutual action plan (targets):
- 2026-04-16: Provide sandbox API key and firewall allowlist (owner: Monica)
- 2026-04-18: Tech kickoff (owner: Dev) — agenda included: streaming sample, tool-call flow, schema alignment
- 2026-04-20: Run 2-hour canary with real test payloads (owner: Rishi)
- 2026-04-21: Post-mortem & tweak allowed model variants (owner: Evelyn + HealthSys)

Monica, please confirm when the sandbox key is ready and paste the allowlist IPs. Rishi, once schedule is set can you coordinate a brief monitoring dashboard (token breakdown + errors)?

Thanks —
Evelyn
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-integration-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 18 KB)]

From: Arvind Rao <arvind@healthsys.io>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura@healthsys.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: Streaming + Tool Calls + Structured Output (Next Steps)

All —

Thanks for the clear plan. Confirming HealthSys availability:
- Tech kickoff: 2026-04-18 09:00 PT (we booked Zoom invite).
- Canary window: 2026-04-20 09:00-11:00 PT. We will send firewall IPs by EOD Monday to infra-team@redwood.ai.

Two quick clarifications from our infra lead:
1) Sandbox API key TTL — we prefer a 7-day TTL for the initial sandbox so we can iterate.
2) Logs / retention — can you confirm the default request/response retention in sandbox and whether we can enable a longer retention for the canary (14 days)?

If you can confirm the two infra items, we are good to proceed.

Regards,
Arvind
Director of Engineering, HealthSys
[Link: https://zoom.us/meeting/abc123-kickoff]
